title: <Short name of the change, as the page's h1 after the issue number>
function: <One paragraph: what the issue asked for and what this plan does about it. The planner writes it; it is not rewritten later.>

baseline.sha: <7-char sha the research and the plan were written against>

milestones.label: Research
milestones.note: <how many commits, or what it settled>

milestones.label: Architecture
milestones.note: <the sections the options and the decomposition come from>

milestones.label: Plan accepted
milestones.ref: <sha of the commit that carried this file>

trail.label: <a dated event: the issue opened, a research commit, a review round>

rows.id: <kebab-case id, stable for the life of the plan>
rows.group: <Code | Tests | Documents | Release | Left for later>
rows.name: <The part, named as a reader would point at it in the code>
rows.where: <its path, abbreviated as the plan documents abbreviate it>

gap.summary: <What is wrong or missing at the baseline. The hole, never the fix.>
evidence: <path:line at the baseline sha — what it shows>

options.name: <An option declined>
options.wins: <Under what condition it would have won>

verdict.summary: <The decision in one or two sentences>

steps.what: <One step: its file and anchor, what changes>
steps.check: <the command or observation that proves it>

followUps.note: <how the follow-up relates to this change>
